optionsHeading.description: Main heading of the settings page.

optionsIntro.message: When a 3D model download starts in this browser, the extension pauses it and asks Bambu Studio MD3 to take it. The browser only cancels its own copy after Bambu Studio MD3 answers that it will ask you first: it names the file, the site and the folder, and downloads nothing until you choose Start download there. Any other answer, or no answer, lets the browser carry on.
